Farmers Protest Cauvery Water Release Amidst Karnataka-Tamil Nadu Dispute

Farmers and Kannada outfits protested near the KRS Dam in Karnataka, suspecting water was being released to Tamil Nadu. This led to the halting of movie screenings in Karnataka. Meanwhile, rains revived in the Cauvery basin, easing the water conflict between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. In a separate development, the BJP staged a protest in Hosapete demanding the release of Tungabhadra water in Karnataka.
